scope: Independent source-bound check of the six DRAFT_REPAIR rows only. Checked exact English keys in current source and current locale neighbors; no fluent approval.

rows.exactSource: Progress could not be loaded or saved. Check your connection or account access.
rows.candidate: Mvelaphanḓa a yo ngo kona u laisiwa kana u vhulungwa. Ṱolani vhuṱumani haṋu kana account access yaṋu.
rows.literalMeaning: The candidate preserves both failure modes (loaded OR saved) and both recovery checks (connection OR account access). `mvelaphanḓa` and `laisa` are present in the current Tshivenda locale; `account access` is an intentional technical loan. Literal meaning: Progress could not be loaded or saved. Check your connection or account access.
rows.rootProposalReason: Uses the existing Tshivenda progress term mvelaphanḓa, the existing load verb laisa (“Ho kundelwa u laisa data”), and save term vhulunga. It preserves both failure modes and the connection/account-access recovery choices.
rows.rootRisk: The passive form laisiwa is derived from the existing load verb but needs Tshivenda grammar review. “account access” remains a technical loan.

rows.candidate: Tshwayani uri modulu iyi yo fhela
rows.literalMeaning: The completion state itself is source-consistent: current locale uses `Yo fhela`, `Zwo fhela`, and `Khoso yo fhela!` for done/complete. However, the candidate relies on `Tshwayani` as “mark”; that form is not present in the current `lib/locales/ve.ts`, despite the packet’s claim that it is an existing locale anchor. Hold the action verb pending verification. Literal meaning: Mark that this module is finished/complete.
rows.rootProposalReason: This aria label and studentMarkDone name the same action on the not-done button. Reusing one source-bound phrase keeps visible and accessible actions aligned.
rows.rootRisk: Shares the same completion-verb uncertainty as studentMarkDone; fluent review should check the paired actions together.

rows.candidate: Slides + ṱhalutshedzo nga ipfi ya English source na clips
rows.literalMeaning: This is an explicit full-pack option beside “Slides only”; the selected-language silent pack remains the default. “English source” is explicit, so this does not promise Tshivenda/regional narration. Literal meaning: Slides plus English source narration and clips.
rows.rootProposalReason: The UI presents this as an explicit full-pack choice alongside the slides-only default for learners whose selected-language narration is not exact. The full-pack note says available English source narration; naming English source avoids implying regional-language narration.
rows.rootRisk: Keep the technical terms and plus-list scope clear; do not shorten this to generic narration or imply every regional deck has a local voice.

rows.literalMeaning: `Ṱolani` matches current Tshivenda imperative usage such as `Ṱolani vhuṱumani haṋu`; the phrase targets understanding, with no Xitsonga wording contamination. Literal meaning: Check your understanding.
rows.rootProposalReason: This is the heading immediately above the lesson quiz. Ṱolani (“check”) is anchored by current Tshivenda UI phrases such as “Ṱolani vhuṱumani haṋu”; it does not reuse Xitsonga Kambela.
rows.rootRisk: The noun construction u pfesesa haṋu is a draft without a matching existing locale key; verify the Tshivenda word/form for understanding.

rows.candidate: Tshwayani uri modulu iyi yo fhela
rows.literalMeaning: Same source-bound concern as studentMarkComplete: the completion state `yo fhela` matches existing completion labels, but `Tshwayani` is not evidenced in the current locale. Keep the paired visible and accessible action under review together. Literal meaning: Mark done / mark that this module is finished.
rows.rootProposalReason: Uses Tshivenda Tshwaya (“mark”) already in the locale and the same fhela completion state used by accepted studentComplete/studentDone labels. The context is a module progress toggle.
rows.rootRisk: The completion pair needs a fluent grammar check; fhela can describe finishing, so confirm that the surrounding “mark” verb clearly makes this a progress-state action.

rows.candidate: Tshwayani uri modulu iyi a yo ngo fhela
rows.literalMeaning: The negation `a yo ngo fhela` clearly negates the current finished state and does not add “yet.” The action verb `Tshwayani` lacks a current locale anchor, so hold the paired toggle wording pending verification. Literal meaning: Mark that this module is not finished.
rows.rootProposalReason: Pairs the positive done-state draft with explicit negation, without adding “yet.” This aria label appears only when the module is currently marked done and the action will undo that state.
rows.rootRisk: Confirm negative concord and that the phrase communicates unmarking completion rather than a claim about whether work has ever been attempted.
